_comment: C-248: split into two lists with different matching rules. `reserved` guards against impersonation and is matched inside the name (Admin_Steve is the attack, not admin). `blocked` is the substring blocklist proper and is empty until someone with authority over the product decides what belongs on it. Entries under `shortReserved` are matched as whole tokens instead of substrings, because a 3-letter substring rule rejects Godwin, Devlin and Testa.
